informational.text: The `ds-time-picker` hour and minute columns run on past either end: after the last value the first comes round again, the selected value is scrolled to the middle of its column, and the column shows no scrollbar. A short column, such as `minuteStep` 15, and the AM/PM column scroll as before.
informational.verify: Open a ds-time-picker, scroll the hour column past its last hour and confirm the first hour follows, then reopen it and confirm the selected hour sits in the middle of the column.
